title: Foreign Economic Policy 1
duration: 30 hours in-class, 15 hours discussion/practice, 90 hours self-study

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the basic concepts, functions, roles, and principles of foreign economic policy.
Analyze international trade policies and their impact on a country's economy.
Analyze international investment policies and their impact on a country's economy.
Conduct research on foreign economic policies and draw lessons for Vietnam.
Collect and analyze data to understand the impact of foreign economic policies.
Work effectively in groups to complete tasks and projects.
Present research findings and policy analysis effectively.
Develop the ability to independently study and learn new material.
Understand professional ethics and social responsibility.
